security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A minimal, modern client for MySQL, DynamoDB and Amazon Athena
bundle.longDescription: A minimal, modern desktop client for MySQL, DynamoDB and Amazon Athena with schema-aware SQL autocomplete, physical-key shortcuts that work under any input source, self-healing MySQL sessions and JSON item editing with a diff before every DynamoDB write.
